name: Macaron
message: 「H-Hey, um... want me to tell you something good?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Today is... believe it or not, my birthday!」

name: Macaron
message: 「O-Oh, I see... You were planning to celebrate for me...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Somehow, just that alone...... feels like it could become a wonderful memory......」

name: Macaron
message: 「To have someone who cherishes the day I was born, it feels like a dream」
